content: The session is a local-first browser image editor (FreetoShop) engineering task. The authoritative source universe is a replay of the first assistant session, anchored by a developer tool prompt (replay_evt_000001) and a long user engineering brief (replay_evt_000002, delivered as spans 000000–000004). The brief defines six ordered milestones: (1) Clone Stamp foundation with explicit source/aligned-unaligned/coordinate/selection/mask/history/persistence behavior and focused tests; (2) retouch/paint workflow completion (Healing Brush, Spot Healing, Patch, Dodge/Burn/Smudge/Sponge/Airbrush, Linear Gradient, Paint Bucket, Vibrance); (3) selection/transform/adjustment/layer workflows (Color Range, magnetic/quick selection, Select and Mask, four-corner perspective, layer alignment/distribution, Curves, adjustment/fill families, layer styles, text leading/tracking); (4) local-first persistence, partial hydration, pinning/eviction, save-does-not-discard-unvisited-resources, document-session abstraction, native/project format and recovery; (5) rendering/format compatibility with optional GPU/WebGPU fallback, byte-exact CPU comparison, bounded region work, and PSD/PSB codec hardening; (6) professional shell, menus/shortcuts/panels/dialogs/accessibility, cross-browser real interaction, CI integrity, and documentation. The assistant begins by inspecting the repository (replay_evt_000003–000009), discovering a monorepo with apps/web and many packages (core-document, command-history, compositor, renderer, raster-engine, selection-engine, filter-engine, transform-engine, text-engine, file-codecs, persistence, pixel-storage, etc.), plus architecture docs (ARCHITECTURE.md, DOCUMENT_MODEL.md) and tool registry files. The snapshot ends at replay_evt_000199, but only the first 11 source items are supplied for compaction; the visible portion ends after the initial architecture/tool-registry reads, before any Clone Stamp implementation. Current state: repository explored, architecture understood, no milestone-1 implementation yet visible in the supplied slice. Uncertainty: later session events beyond the supplied source_ids_in_order are not available, so subsequent actions, failures, and completion status are unknown.

The supplied slice is a continuation of the repository exploration phase, not the Clone Stamp implementation. The assistant reads a large portion of packages/raster-engine/src/index.ts (spans 000005–000016 of replay_evt_000016), exposing deterministic raster primitives: resampling helpers (resamplePixelStore, resampleCoverageStore), layer/image resize (resizeLayer, resizeImage, estimateLayerResizeBytes), transform math (multiplyTransforms, transformPoint, invertTransform, validateTransform), selection/mask coverage queries (selectionCoverage, readSelectionRegion, coverageStoreBounds, layerBoundsFromDocumentBounds), patch construction (makePatchFromRegion, makeCoveragePatchFromRegion, emptyPatch), brush/mask stroke painting (paintStroke, paintMaskStroke, dabCoverage, compositeSourceOver), and brightness adjustment (adjustBrightness, adjustBrightnessPixelStore). The code emphasizes bounded working sets, sparse-aware coverage, and invertible transforms. After the raster-engine read, replay_evt_000017 shows the assistant planning to continue reading raster-engine and to open core-document and command-history. Current state: architecture and core raster/transform/selection primitives are being surveyed; no Clone Stamp milestone work is visible in this slice. Uncertainty: only the first 11 source items are supplied, so later implementation steps, failures, and completion status are unknown.

The slice begins mid-survey of the raster-engine package (replay_evt_000018 shows adjustBrightness implementation details: integer range -255..255, selection-aware patch path, tile-based full-layer loop). Earlier reads (replay_evt_000019, replay_evt_000020) expose core-document layer/mask types and a generic CommandHistory<State> with capacity-bounded undo/redo stacks. The assistant then pivots to Clone Stamp Milestone 1 (replay_evt_000029): reads apps/web/src/editor/types.ts (replay_evt_000030) and edits it to add Tool = ... | 'cloneStamp', CloneSourceAlignMode, CloneSource, CloneStampGesture, and a corresponding Gesture union member (replay_evt_000031 attempt failed validation; replay_evt_000033 succeeded; replay_evt_000034/000036/000038 confirm the edits). ToolFamilyId in toolRegistry.ts is extended with 'cloneStamp' (replay_evt_000039/000040). Surrounding context includes raster-engine tests (paintMaskStroke, transform/selection sampling) and UI shell/ToolOptionsBar reads, but no clone-stamp painting implementation, registry entry, options UI, or tests are shown yet. Current state: types and tool-family id updated; implementation steps planned but not evidenced in this slice. Uncertainty: only the first 24 source items are supplied, so later implementation, failures, and completion status are unknown.

The assistant registers the clone stamp tool in the tool registry (replay_evt_000041–000046), adding 'cloneStamp' to ToolFamilyId and TOOL_REGISTRY with label 'Clone Stamp Tool', icon 'clone', slot 12, shortcut 'S'. It then adds the 'clone' icon to Icon.tsx (replay_evt_000047–000054), appending 'clone' to ICON_NAMES and defining its SVG path. Next, it begins implementing paintCloneStamp in raster-engine/src/index.ts (replay_evt_000055–000061). After reading the file (replay_evt_000056–000058), it first attempts an edit (replay_evt_000059) that introduces CloneStampOptions and a paintCloneStamp skeleton with aligned/unaligned logic, but the implementation is incomplete—containing placeholders, comments about needing source position from the gesture, and returning emptyPatch(). The edit succeeds (replay_evt_000060). The assistant then starts a second edit (replay_evt_000061) to rewrite the function properly, adding sourceX/sourceY to CloneStampOptions, converting the source position to layer-local space, and computing an aligned offset. The rewrite is incomplete in the captured spans. Current state: tool registry and icon updated; paintCloneStamp function exists but is unfinished with placeholder logic. Uncertainty: the final implementation, validation, tests, and integration with the gesture handler are not evidenced in this slice.
